description: This file declares functions and includes related to managing a cache of instance numbers based on unique key search expressions for a software project. It appears to be part of a larger system related to instance selection and cache management.

methods.name: SE_CACHE_Destroy
methods.description: Destroys or frees resources associated with the cache system.

methods.name: SE_CACHE_WatchUniqueKey
methods.description: Sets up a watch on a unique key based on provided parameters and selection context.

methods.name: SE_CACHE_StartSEResolution
methods.description: Begins the process of resolving service instance searches.

methods.name: SE_CACHE_WatchAllUniqueKeysOnUspService
methods.description: Enables watching all unique keys for a given USP service group ID.

methods.name: SE_CACHE_NotifyInstanceAdded
methods.description: Handles notification that a new instance has been added.

methods.name: SE_CACHE_NotifyInstanceDeleted
methods.description: Handles notification that an instance has been deleted.

methods.name: SE_CACHE_RefreshPermissions
methods.description: Refreshes permissions in the cache for a node.

methods.name: SE_CACHE_HandleUspServiceDisconnect
methods.description: Handles disconnection events for USP services.

methods.name: SE_CACHE_Dump
methods.description: Outputs the current state of the cache for debugging or logging.

methods.name: SE_CACHE_IsWatchingSelector
methods.description: Checks if a selector is being watched.

methods.name: SE_CACHE_IsWatchingNode
methods.description: Checks if a node is being watched.

methods.name: SE_CACHE_IsSelectorInstanceStale
methods.description: Determines if a selector instance is stale.
